description: This Java class, ConceptDrugValidator, is part of the OpenMRS core API and provides validation logic for Drug objects, ensuring they have necessary attributes such as a concept. It supports dependency injection through annotations and uses Spring's Validator interface for validation support.

classes.name: ConceptDrugValidator
classes.description: A validator class for Drug objects in OpenMRS, supporting the supports() and validate() methods to ensure Drug objects are correctly configured (e.g., must have a concept).

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if the validator supports validation of a given class type; specifically supports Drug class or subclasses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Drug object, checking if it is null and if its 'concept' property is set. Throws IllegalArgumentException if input is invalid.
